_purpose: Records whose filing prints premium amounts by line of business although every model's extracted mix names none (the PC page readings of 5 October 2026, item 4 of the page report; decision of 5 October 2026). run_analysis.py (load_and_classify, load_composition_lines_in_filing) reads it. A record the extraction reads as a contract form only (a would-be scope exclusion under D3-1), where no other model reads a line and the register holds it, is composition_unavailable with the reason 'extraction_lost_lines': it stays in the target, gets no weights, and is not a scope exclusion. The mix is not rebuilt from the page (D3-1 chose against remapping). Each entry needs the pages read (a filing published as HTML carries html: true), where, a quote, the lines with a positive amount_m in the report's currency (a negative adjustment is not a line; a channel such as MGA Insurance goes in channel_amounts), and the reading; an entry marked _to_complete is skipped, and the run log names it. The register is a hashed input of the run id. THE RULE (decision of 5 October 2026): a book is out of scope only if its filing prints no premium amount by line of business. Lines named in words without amounts stay out of scope, as for 557, 6104, 6117, 6129, 6133, 2689, 1971/2021, 5623/2021 and 1910/2022, which the PC read page by page (the 23 life records are genuine life books and are unchanged).
